source: 人教版2019必修二 Unit 5 同主题完形(学钢琴/筹办音乐节/虚拟合唱团之父/嘻哈舞者/贝多芬/乐队首张专辑)。用词限 U5/初中/常见词,答案唯一,选项同词性,与阅读/听力关不撞文章。答案位稍后打散。

passages.title: Learning the Piano
passages.text: When I was six, my parents wanted me to learn to play the (1)____. To be a good daughter, I agreed, even though I was not very (2)____ in it at all. Surprised and a little terrified, I could only (5)____. Because I was a beginner, I chose a fairly simple (6)____. To play it well, I (7)____ the same piece for an hour every day. On the day of the concert I was so nervous that I almost wanted to give (8)____. As it turned out, all my hard work paid off and I played (9)____. Encouraged by the warm reaction of the audience, I have continued to play and now (10)____ it more every day.

passages.title: The Composer Who Could Not Hear

passages.title: Our First Album
